description: Combines a text field with a time picker.

props.format: Hour cycle used for typing and display, `ampm` or `24hr`. Falls back to the hour cycle of the current locale.
props.hideActions: Hide the Cancel and OK buttons, and automatically update the value when a time is selected.
props.location: Specifies the time picker's location. Can combine by using a space separated string.
props.modelValue: The selected time as a 24-hour `HH:mm` string, or `HH:mm:ss` with **use-seconds**.
props.openOnFocus: Open the time picker menu when the input receives focus.
props.updateOn: Specifies when the text input should update the model value. If empty, the text field will go into read-only state.
